title: so cool but soms bugs
body:
This app is absolutely great. tried it for a week now and it did its job every single day.

however one day it didnt recognize me doing squads. I then changed to photo mode to avoid this bug but unfortunately I faced the same issue there as well two days later (even though I chose an object in my room which doesn't change at all to exactly avoid such problems).
As it didn't recognize my input it never stoped ringing, waking up my girlfriend and probably all my neighbours as well and making me more awake than necesarry (or actually even stressed out).

The only option I had then was to delete the app and reinstall (and setup all alarm settings for the next day again) which is a bit annoying.

aside from that I absolutely love it.
